Two minor cross-occurrence numeric differences were kept as printed: row 82's 'Древесина с корой сосны' TN VED is '4401, 4402, 4404' vs '4401, 4402' in the first occurrence (row 24), and row 97's first object shows OKPD2/TNVED digit sequence '06022' instead of '0602'. No rotated or illegible pages were encountered; ranges are almost all non-numeric qualitative results (выявлено/не выявлено, optionally with 'выявлено в нежизнеспособном состоянии'), with numeric ranges appearing only in row 57 (radiological activity thresholds).
